## Description

Superseded scope (ADR-016): the reviewer queue lists organisation onboarding requests (type Clinic or Hospital, country, submitted date, documents, state), not doctors. The reviewer opens the uploaded documents, then approves, asks for changes with a plain reason, rejects with a reason, or later suspends an approved organisation. The queue reads only the control-plane request and documents through its own narrow, reviewed read path (ADR-014), never patient data. Replaces the interim operations endpoint of MDV-P1-064. The design file still shows the doctor-licence screen and must be redrawn.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an organisation is Submitted, when a reviewer approves it, then reviewer, documents checked and time are recorded and the organisation can register patients.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a reviewer asks for changes or rejects, when it is saved, then the applicant gets the reason in plain words by email and on the status page.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given an organisation is suspended, when staff sign in, then new registration, booking and signing are refused and existing records stay readable for care.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given any queue endpoint, when it returns data, then it holds no patient field (architecture test); every action needs a reason.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
